name: sbaro
description: A robust, scalable, and user-friendly workflow automation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down postgres && docker volume rm sbaro_postgres_data && docker-compose up -d postgres

author: Sbaro Team
